# easydns_glue_records (Data Source)

```terraform
data "easydns_glue_records" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "glue_hosts" {
  value = [for record in data.easydns_glue_records.example.glue_records : record.host]
}
```

Records are sorted by host. A domain with no glue returns an empty list rather than an error.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain that provides the glue.

### Read-Only

- `glue_records` (Attributes List) Glue records, sorted by host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--glue_records))

<a id="nestedatt--glue_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `glue_records`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) The nameserver hostname.
- `ipv4` (String) Published IPv4 address, or null.
- `ipv6` (String) Published IPv6 address, or null.
